key.name: border-width
key.description: Width of the inset status border in CSS pixels.

key.name: border-opacity
key.description: Border opacity from 0 (hidden) to 1 (opaque). Does not change pin or always-on-top state.

key.name: pin-color
key.description: Border color for pinned windows in #rrggbb format.

key.name: above-color
key.description: Border color for always-on-top windows in #rrggbb format.

key.name: both-color
key.description: Border color for windows with both states in #rrggbb format.

key.name: pin-key
key.description: Toggles the focused window's geometry pin. Side-tiled windows become floating at the same size and position. Pins release on fullscreen transitions, display or work area changes, or when application size limits no longer permit the saved rectangle.

key.name: above-key
key.description: Toggles always-on-top on the focused window.

key.name: unpin-all-key
key.description: Unpins every currently pinned window at once.
